title: Commutation Check
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly determine that S commutes with H.

title: Energy Spectrum K=0
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive the correct energies and degeneracies for K=0.

title: Ground State Wavefunctions K=0
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct ground state wavefunctions for K=0.

title: Energy Spectrum K=J
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive the correct energies and degeneracies for K=J.

title: Ground State Wavefunctions K=J
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct ground state wavefunctions for K=J.

title: Incorrect Commutation
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid incorrectly stating that S does not commute with H.

title: Energy Degeneracy Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid mistakes in stating the degeneracies of the energy levels.

title: Wavefunction Normalization
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that the wavefunctions are properly normalized.
